fusions.name: Crumb Raid
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts of shadow in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rafter Drop
fusions.desc: A drop from above that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Skirting Board
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 20% faster; the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Nightfall Scurry
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
